interpretation: 10 additional character timbre presets; the named four processors plus two additional processors = six processors.
changes: 10 additional local character transforms: Bojack-inspired gravelly baritone, velvet storyteller, masked enforcer, digital cyborg, vintage telephone, airy whisper, double-tracked performer, warbling alien, 8-bit arcade and rumbling ogre.
6 processors: hard limiter, peak normalize, humanize, de-esser, noise gate and warm saturation.
Single Android synthesis-to-file -> character transformation -> editable user EQ -> processors -> one processed-audio player. No simultaneous native dry TTS playback for transformed speech.

Voice groups collapse independently: Android voice/language, speed/pitch, character voices, EQ, dynamics/cleanup and creative effects. Character group is initially open; other groups initially collapsed.
Character transform and mix survive manual EQ edits or installed Android voice changes. Settings take effect on next playback; this is not a live mid-utterance EQ re-render.

Silent WhatsApp mode refuses all visible fallback/compose routes and fallback notifications, including expired PendingIntents. Rate limit, contacts verification, app lock, source permissions and explicit silent opt-in are preserved.
A removable contact card shows the attached recipient name/number above the composer. Recipient state clears on navigation, new chat or lock. Contact data renders as text, never HTML.
Keyboard watchdog is bounded under repeated native/resize signals; Android animation busy state recovers if onEnd is lost; textarea value setter defers layout and preserves IME composition/focus.

tests.voice_presets_browser: all 20 presets passed using mocked Android speech bridge
tests.recipient_and_keyboard_browser: 8 checks passed with mocked contacts and simulated keyboard signals
tests.debug_apk_signature: verified; v1 JAR-entry coverage warnings retained in log

limitations: No physical Android device or WhatsApp account used for runtime tests. Notification delivery, OEM keyboard behavior, device audio quality and intelligibility still require on-device testing.
These are original DSP character effects, not a trained Bojack/actor voice clone. Android TTS remains the synthesis source. No Android system-wide voice replacement is installed.

Silent WhatsApp sends require an enabled source, reply permission and a matching live direct-chat notification with a free-form Reply action; unsupported/new/expired chats fail unsent without opening a popup. Submitted is not delivered.
Silent mode intentionally blocks visible drafts until the user turns Silent send off. Incoming-message alert preferences are unchanged.

The optional test APK is debug-signed, not signed with the user existing release key. Do not uninstall an existing release to force installation; use the unchanged release-signing workflow for a normal app update.
validation_notes: Validation caught and corrected a Java field forward-reference issue before final build.

Earlier local native-build attempts hit memory contention and a generated-package mismatch. Final build uses the existing generation scripts with bounded-memory local JVM flags; build scripts and dependencies were not changed.
